## If it changes a leak class, a pattern or a verdict

- [ ] A case it must catch, as a test
- [ ] The realistic look-alike it must not flag, as a test
- [ ] A new class has a seed in `selftest.py`, built from fragments
- [ ] A run that could not look is still NOT EVALUABLE (exit 2), never clean
- [ ] Test fixtures hold no literal secret, private address, home path or real email
- [ ] If the README quick start changed, `examples/check_readme.py` still passes

## Credit

- [ ] Anything adapted from elsewhere is credited (README / DESIGN.md, and NOTICE if its license requires one)
